metadata.question: Between June 15-21, 2017, did temperatures in Needles, California reach 115 degrees fahrenheit?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use ECMWF ERA5-Land hourly 2m air temperature over a 15 km buffer around Needles, CA for 2017-06-15 to 2017-06-22. If empty, fall back to ERA5 hourly.
2. Masking strategy: No cloud masking needed for reanalysis temperature; use all pixels.
3. Logic: Check collection size (C1), then pixel count after reduction (C2). Validate that computed temperature is a finite number within a plausible range (-100 to 180 F); otherwise C3. Compare area max Fahrenheit to 115 F to decide A/B.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const pt = ee.Geometry.Point([-114.6141, 34.8481]); // Needles, CA
    const roi = pt.buffer(15000); // 15 km buffer to capture ~few ERA5-Land pixels
    const start = '2017-06-15';
    const end = '2017-06-22'; // end is exclusive

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check with fallback
    let col = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/HOURLY')
      .filterBounds(roi)
      .filterDate(start, end)
      .select('temperature_2m');
    let dataset = 'ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/HOURLY';
    let size = await col.size().getInfo();
    if (!size || size === 0) {
      // Fallback to ERA5
      col = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5/HOURLY')
        .filterBounds(roi)
        .filterDate(start, end)
        .select('temperature_2m');
      dataset = 'ECMWF/ERA5/HOURLY';
      size = await col.size().getInfo();
      if (!size || size === 0) {
        console.log('Images: 0 (both datasets)');
        console.log('C1');
        return;
      }
    }

    // 3. Processing: time-wise maximum temperature image
    const timeMaxImg = col.max(); // per-pixel max over the time window

    // Pixel count (valid pixels after processing)
    const pixCount = await ee.Number(
      timeMaxImg.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: roi,
        scale: 9000,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('temperature_2m')
    ).getInfo();

    if (!pixCount || pixCount === 0) {
      console.log(`Dataset: ${dataset}; Images: ${size}`);
      console.log('Valid Pixels: 0');
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    // 4. Calculation: area max and mean (for validation), convert to Fahrenheit
    const areaMaxK = await ee.Number(
      timeMaxImg.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.max(),
        geometry: roi,
        scale: 9000,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('temperature_2m')
    ).getInfo();

    const areaMeanK = await ee.Number(
      timeMaxImg.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry: roi,
        scale: 9000,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('temperature_2m')
    ).getInfo();

    const kToF = (k) => (k - 273.15) * 9/5 + 32;
    const maxF = areaMaxK != null ? kToF(areaMaxK) : null;
    const meanF = areaMeanK != null ? kToF(areaMeanK) : null;

    // 5. Validation & Final Answer
    const invalid = (v) => (v === null || v === undefined || Number.isNaN(v) || !Number.isFinite(v));
    if (invalid(maxF) || maxF < -100 || maxF > 180) {
      console.log(`Dataset: ${dataset}; Images: ${size}`);
      console.log(`Valid Pixels: ${pixCount}`);
      console.log(`MaxF: ${maxF}`);
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    console.log(`Location: Needles, CA; Window: ${start} to ${end}`);
    console.log(`Dataset: ${dataset}; Hourly Images: ${size}`);
    console.log(`Valid Pixels (ROI): ${pixCount}`);
    console.log(`MaxF (2m hourly max over time, area max): ${maxF.toFixed(2)}`);
    if (!invalid(meanF)) {
      console.log(`MeanF (of time-max image over ROI): ${meanF.toFixed(2)}`);
    }

    const reached = maxF >= 115.0;
    console.log(reached ? 'A' : 'B');
  } catch (err) {
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
